name: Dr. Dharmendra Singh
position: Senior Professor, Electronics and Communication Engineering Department
description: Dr. Dharmendra Singh is a senior professor at IIT Roorkee and coordinator of the DRONE RESEARCH CENTER. He has received multiple fellowships and awards, including the National GOLD Award for e-Governance (2019-2020). His research focuses on radar, image processing, AI, machine learning, and satellite data applications.

name: Dr. Gulab Singh
description: Dr. Gulab Singh specializes in radar remote sensing techniques, particularly for monitoring glaciers and stored water. His research also includes radar polarimetry and SAR inversion techniques.
research_interests: Radar Remote Sensing of Snowpack and Glaciers
Radar Polarimetry and SAR Data Decomposition

name: Dr. Krishna Mohan Buddhiraju
description: Dr. Krishna Mohan Buddhiraju focuses on satellite image processing and analysis. He leads research in hyperspectral imaging, GIS, and educational content development.
research_interests: Multimedia Educational Content for Image Processing

name: Dr. Avik Bhattacharya
description: Dr. Avik Bhattacharya is a leading researcher in SAR polarimetry and statistical analysis of SAR images. He serves as Editor-in-Chief of the IEEE GEOSCIENCE AND REMOTE SENSING LETTERS (GRSL).
research_interests: Statistical Analysis of Polarimetric SAR Images

name: Dr. Varsha Turkar
description: Dr. Turkar is a performance-driven researcher specializing in digital image processing and machine learning, with expertise in Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) and data analysis.

name: Dr. Sanjay S. Shitole
institution: Usha Mittal Institute of Technology, SNDT Women’s University, Mumbai
description: Dr. Shitole is a researcher focused on remote sensing and image processing, with experience in SAR data analysis and urban applications. He has secured NASA-ISRO funding for machine learning research.

name: Dr. Amiya Kumar Tripathy
institution: Don Bosco Institute of Technology, Mumbai
description: Dr. Tripathy is a data science professor with expertise in AI, IoT, and real-time systems. His research integrates Geo-ICT for agriculture and rural development.

name: Dr. Chandrakanta Ojha
description: Dr. Ojha specializes in microwave remote sensing and satellite radar interferometry. His work focuses on monitoring Earth's surface deformation using geodesy techniques.

name: Dr. Unmesh Khati
position: Faculty, Department of Astronomy, Astrophysics, and Space Engineering
description: Dr. Khati is an expert in SAR remote sensing, working on spaceborne tomography and NASA-ISRO SAR mission algorithms. His research extends to ecosystem monitoring and UAV sensor integration.

name: Dr. Rishikesh Bharti
description: Dr. Bharti's research covers snow and glacier studies, micro-climate modeling, tectonic geomorphology, and ground-penetrating radar for subsurface investigations.
research_interests: Subsurface Investigation using Ground Penetration Radar (GPR)

name: Dr. Vineet Kumar
institution: Tata Institute of Social Sciences (TISS), Mumbai
position: Assistant Professor, Jamsetji Tata School of Disaster Studies
description: Dr. Vineet Kumar is an Assistant Professor at TISS Mumbai, specializing in geospatial applications for disaster studies and sustainability. Previously, he worked as a Geospatial Data Expert at FAO-UN in Rome, Italy.

name: Dr. Mugdha Agarwadkar
institution: A P Shah Institute of Technology
position: Associate Professor, Department of Civil Engineering
description: Dr. Mugdha Agarwadkar is an Associate Professor at A.P. Shah Institute of Technology with expertise in groundwater hydrology and environmental monitoring. She earned her PhD from IIT Bombay in Groundwater Hydrology.

name: Dr. Mousmi Chaurasia
institution: Muffakham Jah College of Engineering and Technology, Hyderabad
position: Professor and Head, Information Technology Department
description: Dr. Mousmi Chaurasia is a Professor and Head of the IT Department at Muffakham Jah College of Engineering and Technology. She has published over 28 papers, holds five patents, and has worked on government projects in South Korea and Saudi Arabia. She received the 2020 Significant Volunteer Award from IEEE Hyderabad Section.

name: Dr. Yogesh Agarwadkar
description: Dr. Yogesh Agarwadkar has over 12 years of research experience, having managed nine research projects and established a research facility at IIT Bombay. He has worked on 10 consultancy projects related to civil engineering applications in environmental and disaster management. He has published seven journal papers and presented 17 conference papers at national and international levels. He also organized the national conference 'Geomatrix' and helped launch IIT Bombay's Research Scholars' Confluence.

name: Dr. Shaunak De
description: Dr. Shaunak De is a senior radar engineer at Capella Space, specializing in machine learning for radar remote sensing. With over eight years of experience, he designs advanced signal processing algorithms for RF data processing, delivering high-resolution radar imagery for applications such as urban planning, disaster management, and environmental monitoring. He has developed methodologies integrating physical radar scattering with deep neural networks and contributed to India's RISAT-1 sensor by creating the first toolbox for compact polarimetric data processing as part of ISRO-sponsored projects.

name: Dr. Shiv Mohan
description: Dr. Shiv Mohan is an eminent scientist specializing in microwave remote sensing. With over 33 years at ISRO, he played a key role in developing India's microwave remote sensing applications, including projects like RISAT and Chandrayaan SAR programs. He has served in over 70 ISRO technical committees and has published 320 research papers. He has been recognized with prestigious awards, including the IEEE GRSS Outstanding Service Award (2022) and the Indian National Remote Sensing Award (1995). Currently, he is a visiting professor at multiple universities and actively contributes to IEEE GRSS initiatives in India.

name: Dr. Anup Das
description: Dr. Anup Das specializes in SAR-based remote sensing applications for geosciences and planetary sciences. He has led multiple spaceborne SAR projects, including ISRO and NASA collaborations like Chandrayaan and NISAR. He is actively involved in ISRO’s planetary mission science planning and has been recognized with the 'Green Asia Award' for his contributions to forest biomass monitoring. He is a Senior Member of IEEE and contributes to India's REDD+ initiatives.

name: Dr. Sujata Ghosh
description: Dr. Sujata Ghosh is a scientist at ADRIN, Hyderabad, with previous experience at ISRO. She holds a degree from Banaras Hindu University and has expertise in government research projects.

name: Dr. Sujata Dash
institution: Defence Terrain Research Laboratory (DTRL), DRDO, New Delhi
description: Dr. Sujata Dash specializes in terrain analysis using multi-sensor satellite imagery. With 21 years at DTRL, she has contributed to geospatial applications for military planning, coastal studies, and disaster preparedness. She has received several awards, including the 'Scientist of the Year' (2006). She holds a Ph.D. in Oceanography from IIT-Delhi and an MBA in Disaster Management.

name: Dr. Pratima Pandey
description: Dr. Pratima Pandey is an expert in glaciological studies, with a focus on optical and SAR data applications for cryospheric research.
research_expertise: Optical and SAR Data Applications for Cryospheric Studies

name: Dr. Paul Rosen
position: Manager, Radar Science and Engineering Section
description: Dr. Paul Rosen leads radar science and engineering research at NASA's Jet Propulsion Laboratory. He specializes in Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) and interferometric methods for geodesy and surface characterization. He played a key role in the Shuttle Radar Topography Mission (SRTM) and received NASA's Exceptional Service and Achievement Medals for his contributions. He also serves as a faculty member at Caltech and has over 30 journal publications.
research_interests: Interferometric Methods for Geodesy and Surface Characterization
